variable_coverage.construction: Compustat PI at t+1 minus MII where reported, divided by the source-defined average total assets; the input is one-year-ahead PTBI. Exact Compustat item-number mapping and average-assets timing remain unresolved.

Annual indicator for the lowest within-year quintile of scaled temporary BTD; source uses federal plus foreign deferred tax expense, falls back to total deferred taxes where missing, excludes state deferred tax, grosses up at 35%, and scales by average assets.
Annual indicator for the highest within-year quintile of scaled temporary BTD, using the source’s deferred-tax construction and 35% gross-up.
Current-year PTBI (Compustat #170 less #49 when minority interest exists), scaled by average total assets; do not infer historical numeric codes from modern field names.
Product of current-year scaled PTBI and the annual low temporary-BTD quintile indicator.
Product of current-year scaled PTBI and the annual high temporary-BTD quintile indicator.

evidence.quote: I begin with a sample of firm-years from 1994–2000 in the intersection of CRSP and Compustat databases
My final sample consists of 14,106 firm-years (4,048 firms).
To be included in the final sample, the observation must not have missing variables used in the regressions
In Equation (2), LNBTD is an indicator variable equal to 1 for firm-years with scaled temporary book-tax differences in the lowest quintile of firms in each year
I scale all variables by average total assets
I use the sum of federal and foreign deferred tax expense (item 269 and item #270, respectively) and where missing I use total deferred taxes (item #50).
All financial statement variables are winsorized (reset) at the 1st and 99th percentiles.

review_notes: Retained the full-sample Equation (2)/Table 3 Panel B fit only. The source explicitly defines annual within-year BTD quintiles for Equation (2); Table 2’s generic partition wording does not override that. The scaling denominator timing and modern field mappings remain unresolved.
